description_en: Manages the logon of AIC instances by associating or dissociating instances based on uploaded AIC public keys
description_zh: AIC实例登录管理，可基于上传的AIC公钥进行实例关联或者取消关联
kebab_example: aliyun ens manage-aic-login --instance-id aic-xxx-1 --action-name open --region cn-hangzhou
name: ManageAICLogin

parameters.help_en:
The name of the public key.
When you set ActionName to open and use the public key to log on, you must first upload the public key by calling UploadAICPublicKey and provide the corresponding KeyName and KeyGroup
parameters.help_zh:
公钥名。

设置 ActionName=open 并使用公钥登录时，请先通过 UploadAICPublicKey 上传公钥，并提供对应的 KeyName 和 KeyGroup
parameters.name: key_name

parameters.help_en:
The group of the public key.
When you set ActionName to open and use the public key to log on, you must first upload the public key by calling UploadAICPublicKey and provide the corresponding KeyName and KeyGroup
parameters.help_zh:
公钥分组。

设置 ActionName=open 并使用公钥登录时，请先通过 UploadAICPublicKey 上传公钥，并提供对应的 KeyName 和 KeyGroup
parameters.name: key_group

parameters.help_en:
The management action.
When this parameter is set to open, the AIC instance must be in the running state. You can call DescribeAICInstances to query the state
parameters.help_zh:
管理动作

设置为 open 时，AIC 实例须处于 running 状态；可通过 DescribeAICInstances 查询 State
parameters.name: action_name
